name: Hammond Manufacturing Company Limited

profile.end_markets: electrical & electronic distributors and OEMs (industrial controls, data center/IT racks, AV, test & measurement); 2025 sales ~63% US, 32% Canada, 5% international (AIF 2025)

plants.products: electrical enclosures, racks; electronic products incl. transformers (HQ)
electronic products (small cases, racks, surge suppressors, transformers)

profile.products: Metallic & non-metallic electrical enclosures, racks/rack cabinets (data-center, voice/data, AV), plastic & die-cast small cases, outlet strips, surge suppressors and electronic (small, low-voltage) transformers; also resale of complementary purchased products. NOT a power/distribution transformer maker — the dry-type transformer business was spun off as Hammond Power Solutions (HPS) in 2001. Link to Sanil is weak (hypothesis peer).
